title: OptimizationStopReason
description: Closed list of reasons an optimization session stopped (Traigent#2508). Mirrors the SDK StopReason literal (traigent/api/types.py). Shared by the session finalize request (SDK sends it) and the finalize response (backend echoes the stored value). Closed enum: no free text and no customer content; a new reason is a contract change made here first.
